history.outcome: GAP FOUND AND FIXED: AyahBadge (surah/ayah number badge used on 4 screens) overflows its fixed 40x40 container at 2x scale. Fix mechanism itself (RN's PixelRatio-based scaling) not directly verifiable in this environment since the test method bypasses it - noted honestly.
